verdict.rationale: Bugbot stores persistent team conventions through repo-level `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` guidelines and admin-created organization-wide rules, and verbose mode shows which rules were loaded for each review. It also exposes an 'Automatically Learn Rules' toggle, which suggests it can build rules on its own, but the evidence is only that one-line mention. Its PR-comment context is documented only for the current PR, and one hands-on report saw it repeat a recommendation the user had already reverted. missing for 10: documentation of what Automatically Learn Rules learns from (e.g. accepted or rejected past review decisions) and how it applies them to future PRs, evidence of memory carrying across PRs beyond hand-written rules, independent corroboration of the learning working in practice.
